facts.name: Battery Care
facts.summary: Battery health and charge cycles, and a reminder to unplug at the charge you choose.
facts.description:
Battery Care tells you how worn your laptop's battery is and helps it last longer.

The desktop card shows the battery's health: how much it holds now compared with when it was new, in watt-hours, and how many charge cycles it has been through.

The menu bar item reminds you to unplug the charger once the battery reaches the charge you choose (80% unless you change it), with one notification per charge. Click it to change the charge, turn the reminder off, or see the details.

On a computer without a battery it says so and does nothing else.
